notes.title: Congrats to HandMade Game!
notes.content:
The circle is now complete!

Developer HandMade Game's self-published sequel [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/331460/]Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle[/url] has won the [b]'Indie Game of the Year'[/b] award last week at 2015 Korea Game Award! 

It is the same award this original game has won back in 2006. It is incredible to think that Rooms franchise is almost a decade old and that both games have won the same award!

Please join us in congratulating HandMade Game on their continued critical acclaim and check out [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/331460/] Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle[/url] on Steam!

notes.title: Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
A sequel that's been 7 years in the making has finally been released on Steam! 

We want to congratulate our partner Hand Made Game for seeing the project through and as fans of Rooms franchise ourselves, it is very exciting to see the game continue through the power of the fans as well.

We've arranged a special deal with Hand Made Game during the first month of the game's release.

For anyone who purchases the new  [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/331460/] Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle on Steam [/url], and has the game in their library, they'll get a 66% discount on the original title Rooms: The Main Building on Steam as well!

Please check out the new  [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/331460/] Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle on Steam [/url] and give Hand Made Game your love and support!

notes.title: Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle is coming soon!
notes.content:
We are happy to relay the announcement from our friends at HandMade Game that their self-published sequel, [b]Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle[/b] is coming soon to Steam!

[b]Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle[/b] is a fully realized sequel to the award winning Rooms: The Main Building. The game has already won the ‘Best of Art’ award at 2014 Tokyo Game Show’s Indie Stream Festival.

HandMade Game is hard at work on putting the finishing touches on [b]Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle[/b]. Please give them your support by visiting the Steam Store Page below!

 [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/331460/] Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle on Steam [/url]

notes.title: Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle is Coming!
notes.content:
The sequel to Rooms: The Main Building is most definitely coming!

Thanks to all the support from the Rooms fans, a new self-published title Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle by our development partner HandMade Game has been greenlit on Steam Greenlight today!

We are incredibly excited to see the Rooms franchise continue and it's all due to many Rooms fans around the world.

If you haven't yet, please drop by the Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle's Greenlight page and leave a comment!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=306841833] Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle on Steam Greenlight [/url]

Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle is coming to Steam in Q1 2015!

notes.title: Celebrate the Announcement of Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle!
notes.content:
[b]Rooms: The Main Building on 50% sale for a week[/b] to celebrate the recent announcement of a self-published sequel to the Rooms franchise, Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle by HandMade Game!

Thank you to all the Rooms fan who've supported the game on multiple platforms throughout the years!

If you haven't, please take a moment to support HandMade Game on their new endeavor by voting Yes on Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle's Greenlight page!

[b][h1][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=306841833] Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle on Steam Greenlight [/url][/h1][/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.02 Released
notes.content:
Gameplay
- Added 'Build' option. Click 'Build' on the title menu and start designing your own Rooms puzzle! Start by dragging in the Room tile from the right side menu and design your own puzzle!

Misc.
- Added a link to new sequel Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle on the title menu. 
Please support the new self-published sequel from HandMade Game on Steam Greenlight!

[b][h1][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=306841833] Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle on Steam Greenlight [/url][/h1][/b]

notes.title: Announcing Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle!
notes.content:
We are very happy to announce a full sequel to Rooms: The Main Building!

Our development partners at HandMade Game are embarking on a new endeavor to self-publish the game on Steam!

We can't be more excited to support them with a continuation of the Rooms franchise.

Please show your support for HandMade Game by voting 'Yes' for Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle on Steam Greenlight!
